every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps each active 3D station cleanly framed in the right viewport across frames 1 to 9, whereas Site 1 lets the UI card overlap background 3D geometry in frames 6 and 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1 translates every concept into concrete mechanical metaphors—such as the hydraulic press in frame 3, the caliper shifting over code blocks in frame 6, and the seven-lane manifold in frames 7 and 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2 exhibits stronger material definition, edge wear, and grounded contact shadows on the machinery in frames 1, 6, and 8, whereas Site 1's dark metal and unshaded blocks in frame 6 look flatter.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 2 uses more concise copy, cleaner spacing, and labeled top navigation across frames 1 to 9, avoiding the denser cards and button-text typo ('ONE20,001-LINE') seen in Site 1 frame 1.

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers a cleaner, better-composed scrollytelling experience with superior 3D material craft and uncluttered typography that stays out of the scene's way.
